summary: Nix research program phases 4+5 for one wave: sonnet deep dives per commissioned subtopic, pipelined into one opus consolidation (or revision) per group
logs: Wave 2: 2 dives across 2 groups (flakesx1, generated-flakesx1); revising: flakes, generated-flakes
Wave 2 done: 2/2 groups consolidated · 29 MUST rules · 12 surprises · 8 follow-ups

top_rules: inputsFrom forwards a package's own buildInputs/nativeBuildInputs, never the package itself — add it to packages too if it must be runnable in-shell (confirmed both empirically and in nixpkgs' mkShell source)
packages= and buildInputs= are functionally identical on mkShell; the distinction is style only, never enforced by any check
Never credit inputsFrom for cc/gcc appearing in a devShell — bare pkgs.mkShell{} already has them because mkShell IS stdenv.mkDerivation under the hood
apps.<system>.default is a fully valid, nix-flake-check-invisible substitute for meta.mainProgram — CI must nix run every package regardless of which spelling it uses
A prebuilt package with several peer binaries and no main one omits meta.mainProgram entirely and forfeits the nix-run promise (E6 exception folded into NIX-FLK-15)
Audit flake outputs only via nix flake show --json | jq, never a flake.nix-only grep — but even a recursive grep misses a directory-convention loader like blueprint's
Lix 2.95.2 does not enforce the overlay's first-arg literal name 'final' (arity-only check) and does not check formatter as a derivation at all — confirmed against Lix's own source, not just behavior
CppNix 2.31.5 (the fleet's promised floor) reproduces the full 2.35.2 output-contract hard/soft table exactly, verbatim error strings included
surprises: Two pre-existing planted fixtures (run-apps-output, run-mainprogram-unset) had an unrelated installPhase bug (wrote to /bin instead of $out/bin) that made both fail at build time regardless of the apps-vs-mainProgram question they existed to isolate — had to build corrected copies to get a real answer

The brief's own named load-bearing run (nix develop on skeleton-a) succeeds but doesn't actually prove what it claims: skeleton-a's nixfmt comes from its explicit packages=, and a bare mkShell{} already resolves cc/gcc with nothing in inputsFrom at all — had to build a pkg-config fixture to isolate the real effect

Lix 2.95.2 silently accepts overlays written self: super: or with swapped argument order, and never checks formatter as a derivation — an agent testing only against Lix would ship flakes that hard-fail on CppNix

package-both's relative path:../producer input fails outright once the consumer is its own separate git repo (git+file:// auto-resolution resolves the relative path against the store copy, not the checkout) — only an absolute path: or --override-input works; live repro of the already-flagged monorepo open question

The flake-parts fixture that already existed (sys/flake-parts-persystem) does NOT demonstrate the 'grep misses composed outputs' claim at all, because its perSystem block is inline in flake.nix — had to build a new fixture with outputs in an imported file to get a real red/green split

Even that new fixture only proves 'flake.nix-only grep' is unreliable — a recursive grep across the whole repo still finds the literal attribute names, so the fully name-invisible blueprint-style case remains unverifiable without vendoring a real directory-convention loader

rule_ids: NIX-FLK-01 — Make every packages/checks/devShells/formatter value a derivation (CppNix-enforced; Lix 2.95.2 skips formatter)
NIX-FLK-02 — Write overlays as curried final: _prev: with no formals (CppNix-enforced; Lix checks arity only)
NIX-FLK-03 — Use only type/program/meta in apps and path/description/welcomeText in templates
NIX-FLK-04 — Emit only plural output names; shim renamed singulars behind builtins.warn for one cycle
NIX-FLK-05 — Do not add a schemas output or delete community outputs to silence unknown-output warnings
NIX-FLK-06 — Do not treat a green flake check as proof a module output works; add a module-evaluating check
NIX-FLK-07 — Never read eval-time files through the flake's own source store path; read the source-tree path
NIX-FLK-08 — Iterate systems with genAttrs over a literal list; never flake-utils, flakeExposed or unmodified nix-systems/default
NIX-FLK-09 — Do not declare x86_64-darwin against nixpkgs 26.11/unstable
NIX-FLK-10 — Adopt flake-parts only to import flake-parts modules or export a flakeModule
NIX-FLK-11 — Read legacyPackages; create at most one configured nixpkgs instance per system in one named binding
NIX-FLK-12 — Never read pkgs.system; use pkgs.stdenv.hostPlatform.system
NIX-FLK-13 — Put each derivation in one callPackage-able package.nix; export packages and overlay from it with equal drvPaths
NIX-FLK-14 — Keep flake.nix a thin entry point with no builder bodies
NIX-FLK-15 — Hardcode meta.mainProgram and smoke-run nix run for every package and every apps entry; multi-binary prebuilts omit it
NIX-FLK-16 — git add every file a git-backed flake reads before evaluating
NIX-FLK-17 — Expose formatter and checks; audit outputs with nix flake show --json split from jq, never a flake.nix grep
NIX-FLK-18 — Write devShells as mkShell with inputsFrom plus packages; prove tools with nix develop -i command -v, never which without -i
NIX-FLK-19 — Count the output-contract check as passed only on CppNix >=2.31.5; on a Lix host rerun it via nixVersions.nix_2_31
conflicts_resolved: Verdict 3 / FLK-01 / FLK-02 overclaimed an implementation-independent contract: Lix 2.95.2 exits 0 on a string formatter and on self: super: / prev: final: overlays (re-run: Lix 0, CppNix 2.35.2 and 2.31.5 exit 1). Scoped to CppNix >=2.31.5, divergence recorded per row, new MUST NIX-FLK-19.

FLK-18 verification replaced: the rerun's 'nix develop … which <tool>' went green on the empty-control violation via the host /usr/bin/pkg-config (nix develop appends the caller PATH). Replaced with 'nix develop -i … bash -c command -v <tool>': control exit 1, inputsfrom-distinctive exit 0, packages/inputsfrom hello pair 0/1.

FLK-17 .checks half: the rerun's red twin oc/alias-noselfsrc (jq exit 4) does not evaluate (undefined variable 'system' in description). Re-run on the evaluating twin alias-noselfsrc gives exit 1; verification now splits nix flake show from jq -e.
FLK-15 apps: the rerun showed apps is a full, equally unchecked nix run path. Kept mainProgram as primary spelling, and the smoke test now covers every apps entry.

Map E6: FLK-15's Applied note 'generator must derive and verify one' contradicted NIX-GEN-13. Rewritten: set mainProgram only for exactly one binary, never guess; multi-binary prebuilts promise no nix run.
M-A-11: the rerun claimed nix develop runs backed the devenv vs nix-direnv default. They compare mkShell spellings only. The tooling choice stays an owner default and is recorded as a documented gap.
FLK-03 floor narrowed: the apps/templates fixtures are outside battery1, so 2.31.5 and Lix were never run on them. Floor now reads CppNix 2.35.2 only.
needs_another_round: packaging/fleet-builders — which expression in nix-installer's closure emits the 56 pkgs.system rename warnings (does crane or rustPlatform read pkgs.system, a blind spot in FLK-12's grep)?
packaging/fleet-builders — do crane, buildRustPackage and uv2nix/pyproject.nix fail FLK-07's cold --no-build, and what is each builder's safe spelling?

inputs/input-types-and-sources — monorepo relative path: inputs: 2.35.2 separate-repo failure measured; the 2.31.5 floor, same-git-tree path:./sub and the sub-flake lock format are still unmeasured (M-A-16).
modules/module-authoring (wave 4) — the smallest checks entry that proves a nixosModules/homeModules output evaluates (FLK-06).
dated re-check at next Lix release — does Lix tighten checkOverlay's argument-name check and formatter-as-derivation (FLK-19 FIXME)?

top_rules: CI gate at 125 pkgs/1,293 versions: `flake check --all-systems --no-build` + smoke build stays under 5s wall on a warm eval cache — evaluation cost is never the reason to skip either half.
Drop x86_64-darwin from any D-flake's systems list on nixpkgs ≥26.11 — reconfirmed live, it errors before anything else evaluates.
A literal builtins.readFile <absolute host path> hits Nix's pure-eval path restriction before IFD is ever reached — distinct error, distinct fix (real flake input or --impure).

autoPatchelfHook fails the WHOLE derivation on any one bundled binary's unresolved dependency, even one nobody runs; fix with per-package, per-soname autoPatchelfIgnoreMissingDeps sourced from the data file, never ["*"] (new NIX-GEN-19).

meta.mainProgram's failure mode is silence, not an error — verify with a real nix run, not source reading: a red twin ran the wrong binary at exit 0; the correct (omitted) form fails loudly at exit 1.
NIX-GEN-17's jq -S . data.json | cmp - data.json must actually be run — the consolidation's own reference fixture fails it (genuinely unsorted keys, not just indent width).

Translate ocx's ${installPath} token to literal $installPath and let bash's own expansion resolve it — never pipe the translated makeWrapper args through lib.escapeShellArgs, which single-quotes and silently blocks that expansion (new NIX-GEN-20).

Map dependency visibility sealed/private→buildInputs, public/interface→propagatedBuildInputs; verified 4/4 on a synthetic chain including one level of real transitive propagation to a grandchild that never references the base dependency directly.
surprises: Neither wave-2 dive ever completed a real sandboxed build of kitware/cmake; doing so this pass revealed autoPatchelfHook fails the whole derivation over one bundled GUI binary (cmake-gui) needing X11/fontconfig/freetype, blocking cmake/ccmake/cpack/ctest too.
The consolidation's own reference fixture (fixtures/nix-generated-flakes/good/data.json) fails its own NIX-GEN-17 rule — genuinely unsorted keys, not merely a 4-space-vs-2-space indent artifact.

A live, exhaustive 122-package census found list env-type and non-empty dependencies are both 0% used in the real ocx index today — M-E-11's dependency-visibility mapping is verified only on synthetic data, honestly recorded as such.

The eval-time-reader alternative hits Nix's pure-evaluation path restriction, a sharper and earlier gate than IFD, before IFD's own rule is ever reached — a distinct failure mode from what the original dive's design (a literal absolute readFile) predicted.
amazon/corretto offers only +libc.glibc and +libc.musl linux/amd64 manifests, no bare offer at all — a platform-relation shape not named in the prior 125-package survey.

lib.escapeShellArgs silently defeats the $installPath shell-expansion the env translator relies on (single-quoting blocks all expansion), and a makeWrapper script moved onto its own original target path execs itself forever with zero error output — both are real, planted-and-caught regressions from this pass's own prototype work, not hypothetical AI-agent mistakes.

rule_ids: NIX-GEN-01 — Commit data.json and read it with fromJSON/readFile; never fetch registry or index data at eval time
NIX-GEN-02 — Build the generator as an ocx subcommand reusing platform.rs; keep platform logic out of the flake repo
NIX-GEN-03 — Emit one version per unique image-index digest; expose other tags as aliases; never drop non-semver digests
NIX-GEN-04 — Select offers through ocx's relation with host {libc.glibc}; drop musl-only, windows and darwin/amd64 offers; never first-match
NIX-GEN-05 — Resolve manifest and config blob per (package, platform); never copy env/binaries/strip across platforms
NIX-GEN-06 — Put only the latest version flat in packages.<system>.<ns>-<pkg>; put all versions and aliases in legacyPackages; omit unoffered systems
NIX-GEN-07 — Make the overlay add exactly one attribute, ocx
NIX-GEN-08 — Fetch layers with nixpkgs fetchurl plus curlOptsList Authorization: Bearer QQ==; verify with --rebuild
NIX-GEN-09 — Pass the OCI digest verbatim as hash; store it once; never convertHash or prefetch
NIX-GEN-10 — Never commit resolved SAS blob URLs, --location-trusted or lib.fakeHash
NIX-GEN-11 — Give every *-linux package autoPatchelfHook plus stdenv.cc.cc.lib regardless of libc tag
NIX-GEN-12 — Always set meta.sourceProvenance = [ binaryNativeCode ] and meta.platforms
NIX-GEN-13 — Set meta.mainProgram only when exactly one binary; check mechanically with gen13-check.sh
NIX-GEN-14 — Split SPDX expressions into ids in the generator; map with getLicenseFromSpdxIdOr; omit license when absent
NIX-GEN-15 — Gate every update on flake check --all-systems --no-build plus a sandboxed smoke run and --rebuild of changed FODs
NIX-GEN-16 — Land updates as reviewed PRs under an App token; per-item failure; no direct push until signatures are verified
NIX-GEN-17 — Keep every digest; emit data.json jq -S canonical; revisit pruning only past 20 MB
NIX-GEN-18 — Once status is populated, keep yanked versions in legacyPackages only and lib.warn deprecated ones; invent no signal before then
NIX-GEN-19 — List exact sonames in a per-package autoPatchelfIgnoreMissingDeps from data.json, only for secondary binaries; never ["*"]

NIX-GEN-20 — Translate env to makeWrapper flags by type with escapeShellArg'd literal segments plus a spliced "$installPath"; throw on unhandled ${…} tokens; map visibility to buildInputs/propagatedBuildInputs
conflicts_resolved: NIX-GEN-20 vs the re-run's fix: hand double-quoting env values into the builder is a build-time shell injection and turns ocx's $${ escape into a PID. Watched: naive variant exit 1 (preINJECTEDpost, 1{workspaceFolder}/x); segment-escaped variant exit 0; an unknown token throws at eval (exit 1). Rule text corrected in place (fixtures/nix-generated-flakes-rev/env-escape/)
NIX-GEN-20 overclaimed that list was verified on synthetic data; the re-run ran no list case. This revision ran one (separator " ", exit 0)
NIX-GEN-13 verification never went red (the old eval-and-compare exited 0 on the red twin); replaced with the mechanical gen13-check.sh: gen13-red exit 1, good exit 0

NIX-GEN-19 text keyed the ignore decision to mainProgram, which multi-binary packages never have under NIX-GEN-13; now keyed to binaries outside the primary command set. The unwatched grep of the wrong file is replaced by a jq check on data.json (star exit 1, named exit 0)

Handoff prototype vs NIX-GEN-11/17/20: glibc-only hook at lib/mk-package.nix:23, data.json not jq -S canonical (byte 48, re-measured), env values double-quoted. Recorded as Verdict 10: the prototype is not a compliant reference
NIX-GEN-01: the eval-time reader hits the pure-eval absolute-path gate before IFD; folded into the rationale and red/green
x86_64-darwin systems drop: cited NIX-FLK-09 instead of adding a new rule
Open questions: removed the 'Closed wave 2' block; moved the eval budget and M-E-11 into the Verdict (M-E-11 as a documented gap)
needs_another_round: Prebuilt Darwin binaries (M-E-10) — do the mirrored archives need install_name_tool/codesign? Needs a real aarch64-darwin build

M-E-11 remainder: token grammar — census which ${…} forms real env values use (:posix/:native, ${self.env.KEY}, $${); decide whether the generator inlines self.env or refuses it
